notes.title: 修复补丁1.0.0.3&集换式卡牌 ，Hotfix1.0.0.3&steam trading card
notes.content:
修复补丁1.0.0.3&集换式卡牌
修复内容：
修复战斗中有几率出现错乱文字
修复战斗结束后有几率出现场景加载失败
修复自动存档引发的问题（任务无法触发）
修复手柄引发问题（场景模型镜头）
修复存档图片显示问题
标注：如果遇到任务无法触发，请重新载入相应自动存档之前的手动存档或自动存档。
侠客风云传前传集换式卡牌已正式上线。

Hotfix1.0.0.3&steam trading card	
Fix：
Fixing misplaced text during combat
Fixing map loading error
Fixing auto save related problems（quest trigger）
Fixing gamepad related problems
Fixing “？”for save picture
Noting：if encounter quest trigger problem，load a pervious manual save instead of auto saving

侠客风云传前传(Tale of Wuxia:The Pre-Sequel) steam trading cards are available now.

notes.title: 致歉声明，Apology to all the players
notes.content:
给玩家们的致歉声明：
《侠客风云传前传》于前日在STEAM平台正式发售，我们在这里感谢玩家们一直以来的支持与喜爱。我们一直在聆听玩家们的声音，玩家们的不快，玩家们的困扰，同样会令我们感到痛心。
《侠客风云传前传》上市以来，因为我们的经验不足出现了不少影响游戏体验的BUG，我们将加班加点尽快修复这些问题，还大家良好的游戏体验。我们也将保证后续会持续的更新改善游戏体验。

Apology to all the players:
Thank  you,all who supported and loved 侠客风云传前传(Tale of Wuxia:The Pre-Sequel) along the way. we have been listening to your voices.
Because our lack of experience,there are still many  bugs that need to find and patchs to make,but, we promise we will do our best to make the patches as soon as possible,and we promise we will continue to perfect the game 




凤凰游戏 FengHuang game   
2017年8月17号

notes.title: HOTFIX1.0.0.2 (UI显示，超级采样，战斗人物消失）（UI,SSAA,missing character)
notes.content:
在研究了问题收集帖之后，我们决定推出紧急修复补丁


修复内容：

1.修复开场战斗中人物描述

2.修复超级采样问题

3.修复天王枪法问题

After researching into the feedback thread ,we have decide to push another patch.
 

FIX:

1.Fixed the UI text in intro battle.

2.Fixed the SSAA option.

3.Fixed the missing character in the intro battle.

notes.title: HOTFIX1.0.0.1(resolution related issue)
notes.content:
After hearing the problem in the community,we decided to push out the first day fix for the game


FIX:

[*] player can change the resolution freely without compromise
[*] the resolution should not pose any item picking problems

                                                                                                              thank you for your support

在听取社区反馈之后，我们决定首先发布第一个快速修正补丁，类似无法修改分辨率以及分辨率影响游戏体验问题应该已被解决。
                                                                                                谢谢大家的支持

notes.title: And we are up!侠客前传正式发售！
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you, everyone who supported us in the past years ,without you,this game will not be possible to be released into steam in the first place.[/h1]


 And we promise there will be more content and fix in the future,we are currently focusing on the future content of the game,all the bugs in the feedback will be dealt with in due time.

Again, thank you everyone who supported Tale of Wuxia:The Pre-Sequel and us
                                                                                                             yours truly
                              [h1]HELUO STUDIO&FENGHUANG GAME[/h1]

武侠梦世界梦！感谢所有支持我们走过这一路的朋友们！没有你们，就不会有侠客风云系列！

此次侠客风云传将会支持中英文双语以及卡片系列，并且我们将会在之后的日子里持续针对内容与bug进行更新修正，希望侠客风云传系列能成为我们走向更广大舞台的敲门石。
最后再次感谢所有一路上支持着我们的所有人，无以为报，只能用更加优秀的作品去呈献给诸位。
                                                                                       河洛工作室&凤凰游戏
